multi_entity_note: Two parties, Azul Linhas Aereas Brasileiras and Avions de Transport Regional, signing on different dates.

contract.document_name.value: Amendment n° 01   to the Global Maintenance Agreement
contract.document_name.rationale: The cover titles the document "Amendment n° 01 to the Global Maintenance Agreement ref. DS/C-3957/14 Issue 7".

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The amendment is "entered into on January 6th, 2016", which is also the second (ATR) signature date; Azul signed on December 18th, 2015.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The amendment takes effect on the date both parties have signed, which is the later signature date of January 6th, 2016.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The amendment runs for the term of the GMA, and no expiry date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Clause 5.1 says the amendment is governed by the laws of the State of New York, U.S.A.; the other New York mentions are statute names, the "performed within" qualifier or the arbitration seat.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The amendment has no renewal provision; five years is the period for which confidentiality survives.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period for preventing renewal is stated.
